_source: Compiled from each vendor's own published crawler documentation, cross-checked 2026-08-12. User-agent substrings change over time as vendors add new crawlers; verify against the vendor's current docs before relying on this list for a compliance decision.

bots.name: ChatGPT-User
bots.purpose: Live browsing triggered by a ChatGPT user action

bots.name: CCBot
bots.purpose: Open corpus crawler, widely used as a training-data source by many AI labs

bots.name: Google-Extended
bots.purpose: Gemini / AI-features training-data token (crawl traffic often rides on the standard Googlebot UA; this token controls robots.txt opt-out, not necessarily a distinct UA string in logs)

bots.name: Applebot-Extended
bots.purpose: Apple Intelligence training-data token, same caveat as Google-Extended
